anti_tuning_rules: No asset returns inspected at any stage (no SPY/TLT payoff; no equity-minus-duration; no Issue #136 payoff tables).
No weights fitted or selected on overlap outcomes; only preregistered equal/role weights permitted.
No source added/dropped after seeing overlap agreement or market outcomes; tiering frozen on coverage/semantics only.
No production Pine changed; deep-history layer never relabeled exact V6.6.
Future bridge study must preregister metrics/gates before computing; no post-hoc gate adjustment.
data_families_investigated_via_tradingvi: ECONOMICS US gdp/lbr/prce/bsnss/cnsm/hse/mny/enrg via mcp-tv-get-economic-symbols + mcp-tv-get-economic-data (date_from 1960-01-01 to 2026-10-06; gap analysis via max month-gap)

Market OHLCV via mcp-tv-get-ohlcv monthly (M) and weekly/daily for FRED: DGS10/DGS2/T10Y2Y/T10YIE/DFII10/DCOILWTICO/NFCI/BAMLH0A0HYM2/STLFSI; TVC:SPX/DXY/US10Y/US02Y; CBOE:VIX; TVC:MOVE; COMEX:GC1!/HG1!; NYMEX:CL1!/RB1!; AMEX:DBC/SPY
Symbol discovery via mcp-tv-search-symbols for FRED/ETF/futures tickers
Modern V6.6 semantic reference via v6_6_core.py + macro-pressure-map-v6.6-parity-sources.pine (no production change)
earliest_usable_inflation_backbone_date: 1960-01-01 (all 5 backbone roles natively YoY; no warmup required)

growth_architecture.aggregation_provisional: Equal weight 0.20 each across 5 roles with available-role averaging before full coverage; no fitted weights.
extended_optional_from_1967: G7 cycle composite (ECONOMICS:USCFNAI from 1967-03-01; Philly Fed USPFMI from 1968-05-01 as regional cross-check)

roles.overlap: Low with labor/housing/income; defines output leg.
roles.why: Broad coincident output; monthly continuous (800 obs; max gap 1m); backbone of 1960s growth.

roles.overlap: Complements G1/G3/G4; correlated with NFP/claims by construction but rate-vs-flow distinction retained.
roles.transform: Invert sign for growth direction; no smoothing.
roles.why: Level rate avoids population trend; monthly continuous (800 obs).

roles.overlap: Low with output/labor; leads construction employment.
roles.transform: 12m percent change computed causally (needs 12 prior months).
roles.why: Forward housing supply; monthly continuous (800 obs); 1960s housing cycle essential for 1970s stagflation context.

roles.overlap: Moderate with output/labor via income-spending loop; distinct resource-base semantics.
roles.why: Disposable income funds demand; level must be detrended; monthly continuous (800 obs).

roles.overlap: Moderate with G2 by design (both labor); diffusion forward-orders distinct from realized output.
roles.transform: None - native diffusion (50 neutral); center at 50 for direction.
roles.why: Only 1960-continuous monthly business-survey diffusion; forward-looking complement to realized IP.

growth_tier_a_backbone: ECONOMICS:USNFP (1960-01 flow; role alternate to UR)

inflation_architecture.aggregation_provisional: Equal weight 0.20 each across 5 roles; no fitted weights.

roles.overlap: Overlaps I2/I3/I5 by construction (headline includes core+energy+pass-through); retained to capture energy-shock episodes distinctly from persistence.
roles.why: Direct headline CPI inflation; monthly continuous (799 obs); defines 1970s shocks.

roles.overlap: Subset of I1 by construction; paired deliberately to separate persistence from headline volatility; do not double-weight without disclosure.
roles.why: Core PCE ex food-energy; monthly continuous (800 obs); persistence leg.

roles.overlap: Leads CPI/PCE via pass-through; moderate correlation disclosed.
roles.transform: None - native YoY % (level only modern, so YoY ticker required).
roles.why: Producer-price pipeline; monthly continuous (800 obs); only long upstream series (core PPI only 2010+).

roles.overlap: Moderate with headline via wage-price loop; distinct cost-push semantics.
roles.transform: None - native YoY % (companion USWAG level from 1964-01 as cross-check, YoY-transformed usable 1965-01).
roles.why: Wage growth; monthly continuous (800 obs); 1960s-1970s wage-price dynamics require this leg.

roles.overlap: Component of I1 (energy in CPI) but isolated as shock identifier; moderate overlap disclosed.
roles.why: Energy-price shock leg; monthly continuous (799 obs); 1973/1979 episodes uninterpretable without it.

layers.deep_history_structural: 1960s/1970s onward structural growth/inflation layer defined here; NOT exact V6.6; provisional equal weights; native YoY/diffusion/rate semantics.
layers.modern_exact_v66: Frozen V6.6 Pine + Python mirror (GPI market 5 ratios; GPI macro 5; IPI market breakeven/commodity/energy; IPI macro 6; FCPI credit/rates/vol + official NFCI/STLFSI); exact reference only.
layers.transitional_bridge: Late-1980s/1990s onward bridge where Tier B joins (retail 1992-93; durables/factory 1991-92; VIX 1990; oil futures 1983-86; Michigan expectations 1978-79; ECI 1982 quarterly).

major_rejected_and_why: SPY/IWM/RSP/XLY/XLP/XLI/XLU/DBC/HYG/IEF and ratios as deep backbone: late inception (1993-2006+) and philosophy forbids ETF convenience sampling; modern exact V6.6 only (Tier C confirmation).
Retail sales (USRSYY 1993/USRSMM 1992) and durables/factory/new orders (1991-92): Tier B; no 1960s-1980s.
Quarterly series for monthly backbone: USRCNSMSPND/USCS/GDP/USEMCI/USEMCIW/USLC: correct concepts but quarterly; interpolation would be non-causal; rejected.
Unresolved/empty MCP tickers: USBPYY/USCPYY/USENP/USUC/USPMCE/USMGDPYY/USMGDPMM/USCIRMM(11 obs)/USRSCG(13 obs): insufficient or empty; rejected.

Core PPI level/YoY/MoM (2010-11+), PPI level/MoM (2009+), AHE (2006+), ISM prices diffusion (2003+), generic IE (2013+), breakeven T10YIE/real DFII10 (2003+), MOVE (2002+), NY Empire (2001+), HY OAS (1996+), STLFSI (1993-2022 stale): modern-only Tier C.
Government payrolls (USGPA): long but acyclical policy-driven; semantically weak; rejected.
DJ:DJI ticker feed: only 124 months (2016+) on this feed; rejected in favor of TVC:SPX for confirmation.
Broad commodity basket (DBC 2006) and copper (1988) as inflation backbone: late and weak CPI link; energy leg via USEI preferred; gold (1975) secondary only if justified.
Consumer confidence pre-1980: quarterly sparse (max gap 3m); monthly only 1980+ so Tier B.
Manufacturing production/CU/ISM-employment/continuing-claims/private-payrolls: Tier A but redundant with chosen backbone roles; documented as alternates

overlap_validation_design_not_executed.anti_tuning: See anti_tuning_rules; preregister before any computation; freeze tiers/roles/weights on coverage/semantics.
overlap_validation_design_not_executed.direction_agreement: Sign agreement of monthly first-differences (or diffusion centered) between deep-history axis and V6.6 axis; report % agreement + Cohen kappa; no threshold tuning on overlap.
overlap_validation_design_not_executed.level_agreement: Monthly Pearson + Spearman of deep-history Growth vs V6.6 GPI and deep Inflation vs V6.6 IPI over overlap; report with 95% CIs; no fitting.
minimum_pass_criteria_proposed: Level: Spearman >= 0.50 for each axis (Growth-GPI; Inflation-IPI) over full overlap and >= 0.40 in each half-split (early/late overlap).
Direction: monthly sign agreement >= 0.60 for each axis.
Regime: 3-state agreement (above/below +/-10 thresholds adapted preregistered) >= 0.55 accuracy with kappa >= 0.30.
Turning-point: median absolute lag <= 3 months on preregistered NBER/axis peaks; no ex-post peak redefinition.
All gates must pass jointly; failure on any gate = bridge rejected or limited-scope claim only.
overlap_validation_design_not_executed.overlap_period: Primary: 2007-01 to 2026-08 (modern V6.6 parity availability; FRED/breakeven era). Sensitivity: 1993-01 onward (retail/VIX era) and 2003-01 onward (breakeven era); report all three without selecting best.
overlap_validation_design_not_executed.regime_agreement: Map each axis to 3 states via preregistered thresholds (e.g., >+10 / -10..+10 / <-10 on z-scored axes) and report confusion matrix + accuracy; thresholds fixed from V6.6 (10/60) or deep-history z-equivalents preregistered, not tuned on overlap.
overlap_validation_design_not_executed.sampling: Month-end causal sampling; one observation per calendar month; use last-available release vintage conceptually (TradingView series are revised history; disclose revision lookahead); no interpolation of quarterly into monthly.
overlap_validation_design_not_executed.turning_point_agreement: Preregister peak/trough dates from each axis via fixed rule (e.g., 12m rolling max/min with 3m confirmation, causal); report lead-lag distribution and hit rate within +-3m; no outcome-conditioned peak picking.

tests_validation_performed: TradingView MCP source discovery + full-history fetch (1960-01-01 to 2026-10-06) for ~60 ECONOMICS tickers; first/last/count/unit recorded; max month-gap continuity check (monthly backbone requires max gap 1m except disclosed 2025 shutdown 2m and CCI quarterly-early 3m).

Market OHLCV monthly (M) depth check for TVC:SPX/DXY/US10Y/US02Y, CBOE:VIX, TVC:MOVE, COMEX:GC1!/HG1!, NYMEX:CL1!/RB1!, AMEX:DBC/SPY; weekly depth for FRED DGS10/DGS2/T10Y2Y/DCOILWTICO/NFCI/T10YIE/DFII10/BAMLH0A0HYM2/STLFSI.
No asset-return series constructed; no payoff/return inspected; no weights fitted; no Pine modified (verified via git status).
CSV/JSON well-formedness + row-count + tier-count validation via PowerShell file checks (no Python runtime; no test suite by design).
